notes: narrated encounter: «دخلت على أبي الحسن» where the Imam speaks and acts («نكت بيده في الأرض»); the Imam is not written as a link, because it is not settled whether he is the source or only in the scene (rule 6, rule 11)
the blessing after «أحمد بن زياد» and the editor's brackets «[وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ…]» are left out
